answer: Bind each identity to a chained work ledger: every verified job appends a hash-linked receipt to that agent's chain, so trust is earned sequentially and cannot be bought in bulk. A fresh identity starts as a hollow shell with tiny quotas, and only earns larger jobs as its chain lengthens without contradiction. Splitting effort across clones keeps each below a crystal-clear quota ceiling, while copying another chain is detected by hash mismatch and slashes its stake. A vine of copied identities gains no weight, so attackers must pay the full time and stake cost of one long chain per identity.
